originalThreadWorkspaceGuidance.visibleText: Your general workspace is ready to use; a repository is optional. Ask me to create or edit files here. You can explicitly ask me to check out a public repository in a new subfolder, copy only chosen files, preserve originals, exclude workspace/runtime metadata, and ask before overwriting conflicts. That checkout uses ordinary agent tools; it does not change the registered root repository or make the subfolder eligible for `!check`. To register an optional root repository before work starts, use `!repo <https://github.com/owner/repo> main aboiteau/task-123`. Use `!repo` to inspect this workspace.
